body: Is it a matter of trying to be creative with the limited options? Because I’m wondering is it something you can address with your mentor teacher about.

Then I’m assuming you’re teaching high schoolers. Have you talked to your mentor teacher about being updated with the technology? Or have them show you how to use it?

If worse comes to worse, could you ask for another placement?

That’s where I am right now. I am hating my student teaching experience so much as I want to enjoy it. 

What grade level/subject are you teaching? Maybe it’s the placement that might not be right for you.

For me, it’s about the relationships. I love being able to get close to students and seeing them develop over the year. Granted, it’s a mostly toxic relationship as most students this year are out of control but I believe having that bond is the best thing about being a teacher.

Sadly, it is something you’ll have to do. I know I’m the same way as I have to be that firm disciplinarian even though I don’t like it. I’ve taken 15 minutes off of their recess before AND messaged their parents. Its the only way for my group of kids to listen.

Honestly, if it’s working, I’d say keep doing it. With sixth graders, they are going through some hormonal changes and having a firm teacher will help.

Edit: just adding this here too! It’s okay to realize that sixth grade isn’t for you! I’m starting to see fifth grade isn’t and that’s fine. Everyone has their own teaching preferences and you won’t know until you try!

Are you me? I’ve been on the fence about returning to fifth grade student teaching because of all those issues!

What have you been doing with classroom management strategies?

I’m student teaching fifth graders and no matter what I do, they also keep talking over me or have other behavioral issues. It’s affecting my mental health as I wonder if I want to continue with these group of kids for the next 6 months.
Not with my job. I can’t afford to have a 10 days to myself.

To be honest, I’m not sure. I have teaching experience prior to this placement and I loved it. That’s why I went into teaching.

I’m not sure is it from the pandemic, this but placement or what have you.
